Drawn because the pooling guard correctly refused to combine the 60-event confirmation draw with the 240-event draw at 2.30.0 — the populations differ (7,780 vs 7,781 events) — and publishing on 60 alone would have reported a 0.9447 lower bound that is a sample-size artifact rather than a measurement, understating as badly as the mass-weighted coverage figure overstated.

The two entries that most needed checking are 226 and 227: `ATIVA em pós-fixada` and `PASSIVO em pós-fixada` both fire in the genuine swap chapter, confirming that retiring the bare `ativo em` / `passivo em` prefs in amendment 62 removed the false positive without costing the real cases.
